claim_en: ויחי תרח ("and Terah lived") — joined by maqqef (the joining hyphen). SNAPSHOT's maqqef column agrees — the ledger's last row opens joined.

בחרן ("in Haran," Terah's death notice) — Rashi: "the nun is INVERTED, to tell you that until Abraham the fierce anger (חרון) of the Omnipotent burned against the world." A letter-FORM tradition: SNAPSHOT carries the letters but no letter-form instrumentation (inverted or oversized letters invisible) — a NEW member of the gap family (letter-size, paseq, paragraph, galgal).

check.note: letter-form (inverted nun) uninstrumented in SNAPSHOT; the plain letters verify trivially, the form-claim cannot
